freeze.hold.description: Irish step dancing, upright with both arms held straight and rigid down at her sides, the hands in fists against the skirt, frozen perfectly still up on the balls of both feet with the legs straight and the feet crossed tightly and turned out, chin lifted, a cool stern look straight ahead
